verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26869796 from Guangzhou PackRight to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318765 (dated 2026-10-12). It confirms two items, both for 2026-12-14. Item 00020 PR-RB-2207 Collector's Box Grand Heist 6 is 23,000 at 25.62 CNY. Item 00010 PR-SL-0604 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 is 125,000 at 0.4143 CNY. Terms are FOB Yantian and NET30. The sleeve artwork is rev. B. Magnets RM-N42-D0401 (4 per box) are fitted by the supplier and included in the box price. The document has no handwriting, stamps or corrections.
observations: Typed PDF; no handwriting, stamps, signatures or corrections visible.
The document has no issue date of its own; the only date besides the confirmed delivery dates is the customer order date, 2026-10-12.
Line items are listed in the order 00020 then 00010.
Quantity and price columns have no unit of measure stated; the currency is CNY.
The header has a Chinese title (订单确认书) alongside English text.
The document does not say whether the supplier's confirmed quantities and dates match the original PO, because the PO is not attached.
